page_title: FRE 1-0 WER | Freiburg v Werder Bremen 07/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) commits a foul during an attacking move.
90+6' Deniz Aytekin interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen).
90+5' The corner is swung into the six-yard box and Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) gets his head on the ball, but he is unable to keep it down and it goes miles over the bar.
90+5' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) is about to take a corner kick.

90+5' Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The ball is out of play. Werder Bremen win a corner kick.
90+4' Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+4' The referee blows his whistle, Freiburg are awarded a corner kick. The ball is cleared after Derry Scherhant (Freiburg) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+2' Referee Deniz Aytekin has finally had enough of Julian Schuster and brandishes a yellow card at him!
90' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen).
88' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
88' The manager makes a subsitution with Jovan Milosevic (Werder Bremen) coming on for Senne Lynen.
86' A cross into the box from Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is cleared.
85' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
84' Daniel Thioune has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) replacing Romano Schmid.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Justin Njinmah departs the field of play to be replaced by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
84' Substitution. Nicolas Hofler (Freiburg) replaces Igor Matanovic.
84' Here is a change. Patrick Osterhage is going off and Julian Schuster gives the last tactical orders to Derry Scherhant (Freiburg).
83' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
82' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman points to the corner flag, Freiburg are going to take it.
80' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Werder Bremen comes to nothing.

80' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Noah Atubolu makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! Corner kick. Werder Bremen will have an opportunity.
79' Werder Bremen failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. Werder Bremen get a corner.
79' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal due to a foul. The Freiburg players look gutted.
78' Maybe there was an infringement in the build up to the Freiburg goal as the referee signals a VAR review. This could get tense.
77' Goal! Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:0.
75' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
73' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
72' A snap shot by Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom left corner, but Noah Atubolu produces a good save to thwart him.
71' The resulting corner from Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
71' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) serves up a nice cross, but Noah Atubolu punches the ball away. Werder Bremen win a corner.
69' Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
68' Julian Schuster decides to make a substitution. Christian Gunter will be replaced by Jordy Makengo (Freiburg).
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jan-Niklas Beste will be replaced by Anthony Jung (Freiburg).
66' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
64' Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle as Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
63' Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
62' Daniel Thioune prepares a substitution. Julian Malatini is replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen).
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Felix Agu (Werder Bremen) replaces Olivier Deman.
62' Flag up against Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
61' Werder Bremen take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

61' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.
60' Werder Bremen are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
58' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just over the bar.
58' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) tackles a bit over-zealously and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.
57' The corner kick from Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
57' Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Freiburg.
56' Substitution. Yuito Suzuki (Freiburg) in, Vincenzo Grifo out.
56' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Freiburg.
54' Werder Bremen take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

54' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman makes the right call and Werder Bremen will have a corner.
52' The ref makes the signal that the yellow is cancelled but immediately brandishes a straight red to Johan Manzambi (Freiburg). He’s distraught but has to leave the field of play.

52' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Johan Manzambi (Freiburg), but referee Deniz Aytekin must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
50' Johan Manzambi (Freiburg) takes out his opponent with a nasty challenge and is relieved when the referee only gives him a booking.
49' Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
48' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
47' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen).
46' Referee Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) makes a rough challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows his whistle for a foul.
43' Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
42' Werder Bremen quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
42' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off. Werder Bremen have been awarded a corner kick.
40' Yukinari Sugawara (Werder Bremen) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
39' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) sends a low pass from outside the box to Romano Schmid. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment.
38' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) heads on.

37' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball has crossed the sideline. Werder Bremen are taking a throw-in.
36' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) commits a rough foul. Deniz Aytekin stops the game and makes a call.
35' Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
33' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
32' Patrick Osterhage (Freiburg) makes a strong challenge and Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul.
31' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Noah Atubolu intercepts the ball.
29' The resulting corner from Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
29' Bruno Ogbus (Freiburg) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. It will be a corner kick for Freiburg.
28' Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
26' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
25' Neat passing move from Freiburg in order to create new attacking opportunities.
23' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.

21' Vincenzo Grifo (Freiburg) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.

19' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the right side of the goal, but Noah Atubolu pulls off a great save to deny him.
18' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post.
17' Maximilian Eggestein (Freiburg) works the corner short.

17' Mio Backhaus produces a crucial save to deny a close-range header from Igor Matanovic (Freiburg) after a cross. A top class save by the keeper. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Freiburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
16' Deniz Aytekin blows for a foul after Christian Gunter (Freiburg) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
13' 1 - 0 Jan-Niklas Beste (Freiburg) has acres of space after latching on to a precise pass into the box. He doesn't hesitate to unleash a great effort which ends up in the left side of the goal.
12' Noah Atubolu (Freiburg) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
11' The corner is swung in but Werder Bremen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
11' A pass into the penalty area from Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) is intercepted by the defence. Werder Bremen force a corner. They send men into the box.
9' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball goes out of play and Freiburg will have a goal kick.
7' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) was too forceful with his tackle and Deniz Aytekin interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
6' Olivier Deman (Werder Bremen) plays a terrific long ball forward to Justin Njinmah, but he can't beat his man and the move breaks down.
5' The Werder Bremen players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
3' Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Werder Bremen will take the kick-off.
Deniz Aytekin will officiate today.
